questions.question: Why do we say a dry bean is a living thing even though it does not grow in the packet?
questions.expected_answer: Inside the bean is a baby plant with a food store. It is resting or dormant. When it gets water and warmth, it swells and grows a root and a shoot, so it was alive all the time.

questions.question: What conditions does dried yeast need to become active, and how can you tell it is active?
questions.expected_answer: It needs water, warmth and food such as sugar. When it is active it feeds on the sugar and gives off a gas, so the mixture becomes frothy and bubbly and dough rises.

questions.question: Why will a fertilised egg hatch when kept warm, but a shop egg will not?
questions.expected_answer: A fertilised egg has a chick starting to grow inside it, using the yolk for food, and warmth lets it grow until it hatches after about 21 days. Most shop eggs are not fertilised, so there is no chick inside to grow.
